episodes.synopsis: A glamorous woman met an unglamorous end inside that phone booth. She's still in there calling for help, but one shouldn't answer her. Keitaro is about to find out why.
episodes.title: Yayoi Hozuki

episodes.synopsis: Keitaro was cursed years ago and receives exorcisms at his grandmother’s shrine. She once warned him not to enter the basement; she locked them away in the dark for a reason.
episodes.title: Keitaro Gentoga

episodes.synopsis: Yayoi and Eiko head to the psychic spot Mizuko Memorial Temple which holds its own sad secrets. And what does Yayoi want with Keitaro’s fingernails?!
episodes.title: Friends

episodes.synopsis: Keitaro had a bad feeling about the Urban Legends class at the university. His instincts were correct: the professor should never have played that cursed videotape.
episodes.title: Eiko Hozuki

episodes.synopsis: Keitaro was looking to make new friends. But he should avoid certain friendships; there’s a reason people warn children to never talk to strangers.
episodes.title: The Freshmen Welcome Event

episodes.synopsis: Camping was to be a reprieve, but the bridge is calling, the bridge is calling, the bridge is calling, the bridge is calLING, THE BRIDGE IS CALLING, THEBRIDGEISCALL-
episodes.title: The Promise

episodes.synopsis: The car had three passengers when it entered the tunnel. A phantom hitchhiker demanded to be the fourth. Let. Her. In.
episodes.title: S Tunnel

episodes.synopsis: The girl’s eyes shine with stars, but two spectral presences haunt her future.
episodes.title: Betrothed to Divinity

episodes.synopsis: Terrifying enough to be victims in life; utterly horrific they remain so in death.
episodes.title: Blasphemy

episodes.synopsis: One does not defy a god lightly. If Yayoi, Keitaro and Eiko wish to save Ai, they must embark on a perilous journey across a country teeming with malevolent ghosts.
episodes.title: Across Japan

episodes.synopsis: No happy tales remain within the castle’s forsaken ruins. The danger is unimaginable: Yayoi and Keitaro risk their doom, prepared as they may be.
episodes.title: S-Rank Danger: Castle H Ruins

episodes.synopsis: None who have encountered the castle spirit survived to tell the tale, but both the living and the dead should fear the High Priest; it is not salvation he prays for.
episodes.title: The Castle H Ruins, Danger Rank S!

episodes.synopsis: The tunnel is dangerous, and they must keep the High Priest in check. It is for that reason the trio need reinforcements; they need another Graduate.
episodes.title: Emancipate

episodes.synopsis: Abandon all hope ye who enter here. There is nothing for anyone in this tunnel, save for the depravity of a sadistic spirit.
episodes.title: Old F Tunnel

episodes.synopsis: The Imprisoned Martyr is dead, but he cannot die. He longs for someone to grant him the death he desperately yearns for, and the F Tunnel ghost could be one such opponent.
episodes.title: Old Old F Tunnel

episodes.synopsis: Eiko did not leave the tunnel unscathed. She experienced the true terror of death, and must now ask herself if her horror obsession is worth risking her life.
episodes.title: House Hunting

episodes.synopsis: Yayoi and Eiko have found the perfect home for the Graduates, but they soon discover the dark history of the family haunting the house—as well as their plans for Eiko.
episodes.title: The House of the Virgin Conception

episodes.synopsis: The god who branded Ai takes an interest in the entity that abducted Yayoi’s mother. That can only mean one thing: a dangerous threat now brews on the horizon.
episodes.title: Morning Twilight

episodes.synopsis: They’ve arrived at an old love hotel to find a Graduate, but Keitaro must locate her in a hidden room while avoiding other ghosts. Dire consequences await if they catch him.
episodes.title: Within the Brothel

episodes.synopsis: A little boy shows Keitaro his drawings as the trio explores an old watergate with a famous spiritualist. To his growing horror, he realizes they are all in imminent danger.
episodes.title: The Old I Watergate: An Innocent Grudge

episodes.synopsis: She was beautiful once, but scorn burned her soul until nothing but spiteful ashes remained. Now, her wrathful fury is the only thing that can defeat a child’s rageful grudge.
episodes.title: The Old I Watergate: Resplendence

episodes.synopsis: The trio walk a dangerous path fraught with peril. Otogiri will not return to her prison willingly, and the spirit that replaced Nagiko is still out there somewhere.
episodes.title: The Old I Watergate: Pleasure District in Flames

episodes.synopsis: Children can be cruel, that much is quite clear. Poor Sakashita lost all he held dear. He plays a game now, the rule is right here: don’t let him find you or you’ll disappear.
episodes.title: Scary School Stories: Hide and Seek

episodes.synopsis: Dorothy has a plan that Yayoi needs to know about, especially since it involves the Spectre of Death.
episodes.title: Scary School Stories: Nightmare

episodes.synopsis: They now have 7 Graduates, but fighting a god also requires an ambitious, daring plan. With Ai’s time running out, the trio prepare for their next journey; Kyoto awaits.
episodes.title: Dark Gathering
